palette_overview.visual_intention: Clean, trustworthy, and accessible design system for enterprise document management
palette_overview.target_users: Enterprise users, document managers, compliance officers, multi-tenant organizations
palette_overview.design_philosophy: Minimalist with clear hierarchy, supporting multiple themes for accessibility

success.description: Green tone for approval and positive feedback

usage_rules.rule: Use primary blue for main call-to-action. Always ensure sufficient contrast with text.
Darken in light theme, lighten in dark theme. Always indicate interactive elements.
Use surface color for secondary backgrounds. Maintain hierarchy with background color.
Use text_main for primary content. Always maintain minimum contrast of 4.5:1.
Use for helper text, timestamps, secondary information. Never use for critical information.
Subtle visual separation. Should not distract from content.
Use for completed actions, confirmations. Never as sole indicator (use icons too).
Use for validation failures, destructive actions. Never as sole indicator (use icons too).
Use for pending actions, cautions. Never as sole indicator (use icons too).
Use for informational content. Can be combined with other visual indicators.

recommendations: Never rely on color alone to convey information
Use icons, patterns, or text labels alongside colors
Test designs with colorblind simulation tools
Provide text descriptions for color-coded elements

implementation_requirements: Color contrast must be verifiable with WCAG contrast checkers
Non-color visual indicators required for all status updates
Icons must accompany semantic color usage
Alternative text descriptions for color-coded information
Support high contrast mode for user preferences
Test with screen readers and assistive technologies

multi_tenant_considerations.tenant_override_strategy: CSS variables allow per-tenant theme injection
multi_tenant_considerations.storage_recommendation: Store tenant color overrides in database with validation
multi_tenant_considerations.recommended_approach: Use CSS custom properties with fallbacks to base palette
